imageAlt: Gemling Legionnaire firing a crossbow for a grenade build

sections.title: Build overview
paragraphs: Explosive Shot handles routine clear while Explosive Grenade and Cluster Grenade provide burst. Oil Grenade lowers the resistance barrier for fire damage, and Flash Grenade gives a defensive stun window.
Gemling Legionnaire rewards skill quality and gem levels, so quality breakpoints and a strong crossbow matter more than chasing a single expensive unique early.
bullets: Keep the crossbow's damage current while leveling.
Use Mirage Archer to automate part of the grenade output.
Prioritise life, resistances, evasion and deflection before luxury damage.

sections.title: Strengths and tradeoffs
pros: Fast clear and strong boss burst.
Good mix of armour, evasion and energy shield.
cons: Dense explosions can be visually noisy.
Late-game cooldown and quality gear can be expensive.
Grenades require fuse and ground-placement awareness.

steps.label: Act 1
body: Use Permafrost Bolts and Fragmentation Rounds, then keep a high-damage crossbow equipped.

steps.label: Act 2
body: Switch clear to Explosive Shot and add Explosive Grenade plus Flash Grenade.

steps.label: Act 3 onward
body: Add Mirage Archer and later Cluster Grenade; take quality-focused Gemling nodes when the gems can benefit.

sections.title: Mapping rotation
paragraphs: Fire Explosive Shot while moving and throw Explosive Grenade into durable packs. Let Mirage Archer cover stragglers; save Flash Grenade for crowded approaches or dangerous rares.

sections.title: Bossing rotation
paragraphs: Apply Oil Grenade, deploy Cluster and Explosive Grenades, then keep attacking with Explosive Shot while the fuses resolve. Do not spend every grenade charge before a phase transition.

items.question: What matters most on the crossbow?
answer: Prioritise high weapon damage and useful projectile skill levels; a current rare crossbow is better than forcing an unrelated unique.

items.question: When should I take Advanced Thaumaturgy?
answer: Take it once the primary grenade skills have enough quality for the node to create meaningful cooldown, projectile or damage gains.
